entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I hope you can help. I bought some cycling shoes a couple of weeks ago, and I just can't use them. I was so excited, but they're causing me so much pain.
Oh, I'm certainly sorry to hear that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?

It's the fit. I've tried everything, I adjusted the cleats over and over, but I keep getting terrible blisters on my heels. I can't even ride. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I really needed this money if they weren't going to work.
Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers, and I completely understand your frustration. Let me see what I can do. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, the name is Alex Miller. Order number is VF903-515.
Thank you, Alex. Pulling that up now... I see the order was delivered 14 days ago. Let me just review the return eligibility for you.
Please, I was so worried I waited too long. I just can't afford to have this money tied up in something that's physically hurting me.
I have good news, Alex. I've checked our policy, and our cycling shoes fall under our 90-day return window. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's... wow, that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Sarah. I was so worried I'd be stuck with them.

You're very welcome. I'm glad we could sort this out. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return shipping label right now. Just place the shoes in the original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. Your refund will be issued once we receive the item.
That's perfect. You've been incredibly helpful. Thank you again.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day!
